text: Esvar Ram Kumar P is an AI Engineer based in Chennai, India, working at HCLTech since September 2025 on Generative AI, multi-agent systems, RAG, NL2SQL, and speech AI solutions for Google and internal enterprise teams.

section: Current Role — AI Engineer at HCLTech (Sep 2025 – Present)
text: At HCLTech (client: Google), Esvar builds production AI systems using Python, Gemini API, Google ADK, MCP, FastAPI, Docker, and Azure. Key projects include: (1) Live Accent Neutralization converting Indian English speech to British English at 2-second end-to-end latency while preserving speaker identity, evaluated across 900+ audio samples with a multi-metric evaluation framework and word-level timing drift detector; (2) Multi-Agent Retail Location Strategy, a 6-agent system (Orchestrator, Research, Competitor, Gap Analysis, Strategy, Report) using Google ADK, Google Maps MCP, Geocoding API, and Google Search that reduced site-feasibility analysis within a 10 km radius from 5 hours to 90 seconds with an explainable 0–100 viability score; (3) AI-Powered Business Assistant, an internal NL2SQL Microsoft Teams bot over an 18-table SQL database deployed via FastAPI, Docker, Azure App Service, and Azure DevOps, raising accuracy from 65% to 85% on a 190-question evaluation harness and serving 50+ daily business users.
